title: Granite Ridge Mountain Operations: Season Dates, Mountains and Day Limits by Pass Tier
content:
## What each tier of the Season Pass Programme admits the holder to

Every season pass in the Granite Ridge Mountain Collective is sold against one season, which opens on 2026-11-20 and closes on 2027-04-18 on every tier. Against that season the tier fixes the number of scheduled operating days it admits the holder on, the mountains it admits the holder to, whether it is limited to Monday through Friday, the dates it does not admit the holder, whether the published holiday periods are open to it, the number of days it admits the holder at partner resorts outside the collective, whether the holder may scan at more than one mountain on the same calendar day, and the maximum number of lift scans recorded against it on one calendar day.

| Tier | Operating days included | Mountains | Midweek only | Holiday access | Partner resort days | More than one mountain a day | Daily scan limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 4 | Granite Ridge | no | no | 0 | no | 14 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 107 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek | yes | no | 0 | no | 14 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 150 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow | no | no | 0 | yes | 16 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 150 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | no | no | 0 | yes | 18 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | 150 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | no | yes | 5 | yes | 20 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 150 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | no | yes | 10 | yes | 24 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | 150 | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow | no | yes | 21 | yes | 30 |

### Blackout dates published per tier

| Tier | Dates on which the tier does not admit the holder |
| --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | 2026-12-26 through 2027-01-02, 2027-01-16 through 2027-01-18, 2027-02-13 through 2027-02-15 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 2026-12-28 through 2026-12-31, 2027-01-18, 2027-02-15 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | 2026-12-26 through 2027-01-02 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | 2026-12-26, 2026-12-27, 2026-12-31, 2027-01-01 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | none published |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | none published |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | none published |

The three tiers with no blackout dates published are the three that also carry holiday access. Partner resort days are published as a count of days at resorts outside the collective and stand at 0 on the four lowest tiers.
